purpose: Cross-source review of Venetian and Genoese presence, trade nodes, enclaves, family lordships, and maritime anchors around the Aegean and adjacent Anatolian coasts.
sourcePrinciples: Merchant presence is not equivalent to territorial sovereignty.
A later Genoese/Venetian colony is not back-projected into the 1326 snapshot.
Commercial agreements and consulates are dated independently from political control.
Canonical political geometry is not promoted from this review alone.

sources.provider: Cambridge History of the Byzantine Empire

sources.role: Venetian Crete, Menteshe and Aydin documentary trade evidence
Venetian/Genoese grain trade and western Anatolian ports
Northern Aegean geography and Latin archival evidence
Anaia/Kadıkalesi port, dockyard and primary Latin-source evidence
Tenedos and the Dardanelles strategic maritime context

nodes.name: Chios/Sakız
nodes.temporalEvidence: Zaccaria control began in 1304 and ended with Byzantine recovery in 1329.

nodes.name: Phocaea/Foça
nodes.temporalEvidence: Zaccaria/Cattaneo control is documented in the early fourteenth century; later Maona arrangements must not be projected backward.

nodes.name: Smyrna/İzmir
nodes.temporalEvidence: Zaccaria captured the port in 1317; Aydinid recovery is later, around 1329.

nodes.name: Ayasuluk/Selçuk
nodes.1326Status: Aydinid-controlled port with Latin merchant activity
nodes.temporalEvidence: Later Venetian consular evidence is not back-projected to 1326.

nodes.name: Anaia/Kadıkalesi
nodes.temporalEvidence: Primary Genoese/Venetian records, portolans and archaeology support the port and maritime infrastructure; political control remains separately date-scoped.

nodes.name: Balat/Palatia
nodes.temporalEvidence: Venetian relations with Menteshe predate 1326; later treaty/consular dates are kept separate.

nodes.name: Galata/Pera
nodes.1326Status: Genoese urban-commercial enclave under Byzantine sovereignty
nodes.temporalEvidence: Genoese privileges and settlement precede 1326; later wall expansions are not back-projected.

nodes.name: Trebizond/Trabzon
nodes.1326Status: Trapezuntine sovereign city with Genoese/Venetian merchant presence
nodes.temporalEvidence: Venetian commercial privileges are documented by 1319; this does not imply Venetian sovereignty.

nodes.name: Caffa/Kefe
nodes.temporalEvidence: Established Genoese colonial centre in the Black Sea system by the early fourteenth century.

nodes.name: Tana
nodes.1326Status: Genoese/Italian trade node; exact 1326 institutional status requires date-specific verification
nodes.temporalEvidence: Italian access and Genoese expansion are documented in the early fourteenth century, but later interruptions are not back-projected.

nodes.name: Soldaia/Sudak
nodes.temporalEvidence: Genoese settlement is documented from the late thirteenth century; 1326 administrative detail remains to be refined.

nodes.name: Sinop
nodes.1326Status: Local Anatolian/Black Sea port; Genoese-colony status not promoted for 1326
nodes.temporalEvidence: Later Genoese settlement evidence may date to the mid/late fourteenth century; it is not back-projected.

nodes.name: Amasra/Samastri
nodes.1326Status: Local Black Sea port; Genoese-colony status deferred
nodes.temporalEvidence: Later Genoese settlement evidence is insufficiently early for automatic 1326 promotion.

nodes.name: Rhodes
nodes.temporalEvidence: Hospitallers took Rhodes in 1309; this is distinct from Venetian/Genoese sovereignty.

nodes.name: Tenedos/Bozcaada
nodes.1326Status: Not promoted as Venetian possession at scenario start
nodes.temporalEvidence: Major Venetian/Genoese strategic interest is documented, but the later Venetian occupation belongs to the late fourteenth century.

networkRules.politicalSovereignty: owner/controller state only when independently date-supported
networkRules.familyLordship: represent as a distinct political relation, not automatically Genoa republic territory
networkRules.fondaco: commercial institution; does not imply sovereign control
networkRules.consulate: institutional presence; date separately from political control
networkRules.tradeRoute: network edge independent of political border

promotionGate: canonical geometry remains unpromoted until spatial reconstruction
